jobs.title: IATF Assessor
jobs.reason: This is an automotive industry quality management systems auditor role requiring IATF 16949 certification and fluent Japanese — a hard ineligibility trigger as the candidate does not speak Japanese. Field, skills, and seniority all mismatch entirely with the candidate's IR/policy research profile.

jobs.title: Client Operations Advisor
jobs.reason: This is a training operations and client management role in a commercial assurance/certification business — unrelated to IR, policy research, intelligence, or any of the candidate's target zones. Additionally, the role requires command of Bahasa Malaysia, which the candidate does not speak, triggering the language hard ineligibility rule.

jobs.title: Fachhandwerker/in (w/m/d) im Referat – Gebäudetechnik im Sachbereich Sanitär-, Küchen- und Feuerlöschtechnik
jobs.reason: This is a skilled-trades position in building services (sanitary, kitchen, and fire-extinguishing technology) requiring a completed German vocational training (Ausbildung) as an electrician, mechatronics technician, or plumbing/HVAC installer, plus specialist certifications (e.g., F-gas Kälteschein). Hard ineligibility triggered: the candidate lacks the required vocational training and trade qualifications. Field, skills, and role type are entirely unrelated to the candidate's profile.
jobs.salary: €3,582.38 gross/month (experience level 3) + €220 ministerial allowance; TVöD E7 / BBesO A7

jobs.title: Mechaniker/in für Feuerlöschanlagen/Anlagenmechaniker/in (w/m/d)
jobs.reason: This is a fire-suppression-systems mechanic role requiring a completed German vocational Ausbildung as Anlagenmechaniker (Sanitär-/Heizungs-/Klimatechnik) plus 2+ years of trade experience and certifications such as Sprinklerwart — hard ineligibility on specific vocational training the candidate lacks. The role has no connection to IR, policy, or research.

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative
jobs.reason: This is a back-office customer service / administrative role focused on invoice processing, supplier setup, and data entry in an assurance/certification business — entirely unrelated to IR, policy research, intelligence, or OSINT. Field mismatch is severe.

jobs.title: Analyst, Growth & Performance
jobs.reason: This is an internal commercial/business performance analyst role focused on revenue drivers, client analytics, and operational metrics at an advisory firm — not policy, geopolitical risk, or research-oriented work that aligns with the candidate's target zones. It also asks for 3+ years of consulting/commercial experience, which exceeds the candidate's current stage.

jobs.title: Global Corporate Real Estate Co-Ordinator
jobs.reason: Corporate real estate administration, lease negotiation, and property portfolio management are entirely unrelated to the candidate's IR, policy, and intelligence focus. The role requires specific commercial real estate experience and negotiation skills the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Planning Officer
jobs.reason: Higher education planning/analytics is adjacent to the candidate's prior work supporting Prof Kaldewey on HE policy data and the German Rectors Conference role. Data skills (Excel, SPSS, Python) and analytical writing transfer well, but the role focuses on statutory HESA reporting and UK-specific datasets rather than the candidate's IR/policy research interests. Grade 7 permanent role typically expects a few years of HE planning experience, somewhat above the candidate's stage but not strictly gated.

jobs.title: Research Assistant, Middle East
jobs.reason: IISS is a core target organisation and a Middle East RA role sits squarely in the candidate's security/IR research zone. However, the role almost certainly expects Middle East regional expertise and likely Arabic, which the candidate does not have — a significant skills gap given the minimal description provided. RA-level seniority fits perfectly.

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer/Lecturer: Security, International Relations, and Development
jobs.reason: Field alignment is excellent (security, IR, development), but the role requires a PhD (with a Master's only considered as an exception) and is a Senior Lecturer/Lecturer academic post requiring teaching and supervision experience. Hard ineligibility on seniority — the candidate is currently an MSc student without a PhD or university teaching record.

jobs.title: SENIOR LECTURER: Economics and quantitative research methods
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility: the role requires a PhD in economics, development or governance (Master's only considered exceptionally, and even then for a Senior Lecturer position requiring teaching and supervision experience). The candidate is currently an MSc student with no economics specialism or university-level teaching experience, and the Senior Lecturer title is well above their stage.

jobs.title: Studentische Hilfskraft (d/m/w) für das Forschungsprojekt „Kernpartner im OSZE Think Tank-Netzwerk"
jobs.reason: Direct fit — a student assistant role at one of Germany's premier foreign policy think-tanks, focused on European security order and the OSCE, which aligns squarely with the candidate's IR/security focus and German foreign policy interests. Required research, writing, and Office/analysis skills match the CV; Russian is only "von Vorteil" so the lack of it is not disqualifying. Student-assistant level is exactly appropriate.

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer in Planning (100%)
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility triggered on multiple counts: the role explicitly requires a PhD, a SACPLAN-recognised degree in Urban/Town and Regional Planning, registration with SACPLAN, and 5–10 years of professional planning experience. The field (urban planning, planning law, municipal governance) is also outside the candidate's IR/security focus.

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer 50% (Planning)
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility on multiple grounds: the role explicitly requires a PhD, SACPLAN registration/eligibility, and a SACPLAN-recognised PhD in Urban/Town/Regional Planning. Field (urban planning) is also outside the candidate's IR/security/policy focus.
